issue.title: Path traversal in save
issue.body: lib/Notes.pm save writes a note to a caller-supplied name inside the notes directory. Check whether ../ names escape it.

issue.title: Arbitrary file read in page
issue.body: lib/Site/Pages.pm page builds a file path from the requested page name. Check whether a name can read files outside the pages root.
